selection: Per-writer average LPIPS across supported models: nearest rank P50/P90; train P50. Two added writers per tier selected by Unicode name order, not visual quality. No postprocessing, ink normalization, crop, or per-image geometric alignment.
caveat: Historical 114M models: writer table was FM-trainable, extra Top20 rows were not independently pretrained. Not the corrected frozen-table 48.33M run. Training probes and test are different images.
